subject.title: Android: Add message copy and text selection to chat screen

question: Should Android chat long-press ship only Copy and Select Copy first, or should Share and Reply be included in the same core UI change?
rationale: The source gap is clear, but Share and Reply add product semantics beyond basic text reuse and prior attempts showed reply-context and pointer-event concerns.

options.title: Copy/select first
options.body: Approve a narrow Android action surface for whole-message copy and selective copy, leaving Share and Reply for separate follow-ups.

options.title: Full action sheet
options.body: Approve Copy, Select Copy, Share, and Reply together, with explicit reply semantics and proof that link tapping and scrolling still work.

options.title: Adopt external fork
options.body: Ask the external fork PR author to refresh the conflicting branch and resolve the known action-scope issues before maintainer review.

recommendation.title: Copy/select first
recommendation.body: Approve a narrow Android action surface for whole-message copy and selective copy, leaving Share and Reply for separate follow-ups.
